title: Moth's Creeper Redone
description: A small texturepack that makes the creeper cute and spooky!
body:
# Welcome to my (Moth's) Creeper Redone texture pack!

My very first texture pack ever which changes the model and textures of the creeper to be strangely cute and spooky.
My future goal now is to recreate more mobs in my art style for this texture pack. Stay tuned for more texture changes and revamps!

![A creeper pondering](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a5a417f8f7cd9cb0d036567d4f3028631cd247c7.jpeg)

Requires: **Optifine** or **EMF + ETF** (Because the models are changed :p)
